title: Health evidence and assistive-input foundations
purpose: Build substantive, openly reusable scientific knowledge, factual evidence data, and inspectable engineering code, starting with ALS and sampled digital inputs.

affected_communities.community_name: People studying ALS, scientific contributors, educators, and accessible-technology builders
affected_communities.involvement_in_design: This is an AI-assisted public educational contribution; no patient or community co-design is recorded for this edition.

deliverables: Embedded ALS evidence and trial-fact records
Embedded cancer biology and evidence foundations with an original primer
A synthetic switch-signal laboratory with executable code and lesson

governance.scientific_review: Qualified clinical and research reviewers should inspect the medical synthesis before endorsing it.

privacy: Public source facts and synthetic signals only; no participant-level or personal records.

resources.runtime: Python standard library and text reader
